fields.name: last_change
fields.meaning: The latest commit time among non-merge commits touching this exact path at the pinned revision.

fields.name: commit_count
fields.meaning: The number of non-merge commits touching this exact path at the pinned revision.

fields.name: added_at
fields.meaning: When the latest period of this path's existence began: the committer date of the first commit that added it after its last removal.

fields.name: added_in
fields.meaning: The commit that began the latest period of this path's existence.

fields.name: removed_at
fields.meaning: When the latest period of this path's existence ended: the committer date of the commit that deleted or renamed it away; empty while the path stands in the current tree.

fields.name: removed_in
fields.meaning: The commit that ended the latest period of this path's existence; empty while the path stands in the current tree.
